description: The full report: exact fill and slippage for your size, total cost including fees and builder fee, the breakeven probability you need to believe, reward eligibility and payout estimate, net edge against your own probability estimate, and a verdict (operate / operate_partial / do_not_operate / insufficient_data) with the reasons enumerated. Send your book and the market config; nothing is stored.

book.description: Order book: bids and asks with price and size in shares

category.description: Market category, sets the fee rate

your_probability.description: Your own probability estimate. Without it the report returns the breakeven and no verdict.

title: Market brief: trade this market or not
